content.answer_markdown: This Recommendation proposes the Trade Lines to rebalance the Portfolio back to its Target Allocation by Asset Class. Currently, the Portfolio has a significant drift: bonds are underweight by 25.0 percentage points (actual 40.01% vs target 65.0%), and cash is overweight by 25.01 percentage points (actual 40.01% vs target 15.0%). Equity is essentially on target. To correct this, the Recommendation includes selling SGOV (iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF) which is overweight at 25.01% of the Portfolio, and buying AGG (iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF) and SHY (iShares 1-3 Year Treasury Bond ETF) to increase bond exposure closer to the 65% target and reduce cash exposure to the 15% target. The turnover is 25.0% of the Portfolio, reflecting the scale of rebalancing needed. The trade sizes also exceed the platform's thresholds for turnover and single Trade Line percentages, indicating high impact trades requiring advisor and committee approval.
